items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Yeah, I played a long time with John.

ctx.x: Yeah, they're both using Timber. And Mother's Day she'd keep working with John. So that's the way they worked. Well that's the way it was going in them days.
Did you work steady with John ever? Yeah, I played a long time with John. When was that?
Oh, before I'd taken sick, I used to play with him.

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Yeah, I played with John, quite a while.

ctx.x: Did you play in the Young Tuxedo ever?
Yeah, I played with John, quite a while. Any of the other bands? I played with Eddie Jackson, when he had the original Tuxedo.
